jobs.title: AI Implementation Specialist
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Lab3 is a third\-party logistics (3PL) provider offering direct\-to\-consumer and wholesale fulfillment services from our New Jersey facility. This is a hands\-on building role. Approximately 80% of the time will be spent developing solutions within AI platforms such as ChatGPT and Claude, and approximately 20% coordinating with team members to roll those solutions out. The position reports to the CTO/COO. Initial projects include: * **Customer service request management.** Build a human\-in\-the\-loop system that captures incoming requests from email, WhatsApp, and phone, routes them to the appropriate team member, tracks follow\-up, and confirms resolution. * **Billing.** Automate invoice generation, invoice auditing, and billing status tracking. * **Later phases.** Service\-level (SLA) tracking and warehouse operations processes. **Responsibilities** * Identify manual, repetitive, or error\-prone processes and propose practical AI\-based solutions * Design, build, test, and maintain automations, agents, scheduled tasks, and workflows within AI platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, and similar tools) * Evaluate and integrate complementary automation tools (for example, Zapier or Make) where appropriate * Take ownership of assigned problems from initial discussion through delivery, including testing and iteration based on feedback * Document workflows and tools so that team members can use and maintain them * Communicate progress, options, and trade\-offs clearly to leadership and end users **Qualifications** * Demonstrated hands\-on experience building solutions with AI platforms such as ChatGPT or Claude, including agents, custom GPTs or projects, scheduled tasks, or automated workflows * Ability to take a loosely defined business problem and deliver a working solution with minimal supervision * Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several projects at once * Clear written and verbal communication skills * An understanding of business processes and how to improve them * Comfort working with systems and data; programming experience is not required Early\-career candidates and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **About Arena Intelligence** ============================ Arena is the platform for evaluating how AI models perform in the real world. Founded by researchers from UC Berkeley's SkyLab, we're on a mission to measure and advance the frontier of AI for real\-world use, and to build the foundation for everyone to understand, shape, and benefit from it. Tens of millions of people use Arena each month to evaluate how frontier systems handle the work they actually do. The preferences they share power the most transparent, rigorous, and human\-centered evaluations in AI. Leading AI labs, enterprises, and independent researchers rely on our work and open datasets to understand how models behave in real workflows: agentic coding, creative generation, professional productivity, and beyond. We go beyond leaderboards and decompose what human experience reveals about AI, so models advance toward the work people actually do. We're a team of researchers, academics, builders, and creatives from UC Berkeley, Google, Stanford, and DeepMind. We seek truth, move fast, and value craftsmanship, curiosity, and impact over hierarchy. We're building a company where thoughtful, curious people from all backgrounds can do their best work together, in an office culture that radiates excellence, energy, and focus. ### **About the Role** This role has two core parts, both centered around working closely with the best AI labs in the world. First, you’ll partner directly with our lab customers to integrate their models, run and deliver evals, and act as their go\-to person at Arena Intelligence. You’ll plug into their research roadmap, understand where they’re headed, and help them get real value from our data. Along the way, you’ll spot gaps, surface new opportunities, and help shape what we build next. Second, you’ll roll up your sleeves and build. You’ll take on specific customer engineering asks and ship solutions that push the frontier of what our platform can do. Some of what you build may eventually scale into our Data or Applied ML stack — but it starts with solving real, high\-impact problems for cutting\-edge AI teams. ### **You’ll** * Own 5–15 active model lab relationships as the day\-to\-day point of contact * Partner directly with researchers and product teams to integrate models, run evals, and deliver high\-quality results * Drive consistent delivery across onboarding, data \+ product releases, co\-launches, and unblock unexpected issues fast * Be the “owner” of a key process improvement or automation (e.g., model onboarding flow, customer data insights, delivery tooling) * Translate customer feedback and research direction into concrete product ideas and engineering work * Work across the stack to ship pragmatic solutions that push the frontier for our customers * Help expand strategic accounts through trust, execution, and sharp technical judgment ### **You’ll have** * 4\+ years of software engineering experience with strong fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design) * Production experience in **TypeScript** and modern web frameworks * Hands\-on experience integrating LLM provider APIs, including streaming responses * Comfort moving across frontend and backend — you’re willing to dig in wherever the problem is * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD workflows * Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to operate in ambiguity * Clear, concise communication skills — you can explain complex technical ideas to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders * A customer\-first mindset and a genuine desire to work closely with multiple stakeholders **What we offer** ================= * We offer competitive compensation and equity aligned to the markets where our team members are based. The base salary range will depend on the candidate’s permanent work location. * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and additional support programs. * The opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI with a small, mission\-driven team * A culture that values transparency, trust, and community impact Come help build the space where anyone can explore and help shape the future of AI. Arena Intelligence *provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.* Compensation Range: $150K \- $250K

jobs.title: Database Engineer, AWS Data Platforms
jobs.description: Peregrine Advisors is a firm founded on a simple conviction: the best solutions come from the people closest to the problem, given real ownership and the tools to deliver. We are a data and technology innovation hub and a Benefit Corporation working at the center of the federal government's mission to deliver for client stakeholders and the US public, looking for highly motivated contributors who thrive when trusted to own a hard problem and equipped to deliver the solution. **Your first assignment** In your first assignment, you will own the queries, stored procedures, views, and logical data models for your assigned part of a federal agency's enterprise data platform. You will build and maintain these components in Amazon Aurora and the platform stores alongside it, taking responsibility for their accuracy and performance. You will make database\-design decisions within the established platform architecture and carry your work through implementation and ongoing maintenance. The work is real and hard, and it matters. This first assignment is a starting point, not the shape of your career here. We hire people, not seats, and move our best to where the hardest problems are. **What you'll build** * Reliable Structured Query Language (SQL) queries, stored procedures, and views in Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible) that work with DynamoDB, Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\), and Apache Iceberg tables and turn raw data into something people can use. * Logical data models and database schemas for your assigned components, designed to keep the relational and platform stores working together within the established platform architecture. * Tuned queries, S3 data loads into the platform stores, and connectivity, all under governed access. * And over time, the firm itself, through the new capabilities, tools, and lines of business you help launch. **Who you are** You enjoy building with SQL and take responsibility for getting data right. You can take a database problem from design through delivery and stand behind how your work performs. You experiment, learn from failure, and try again quickly. You would rather own an outcome than simply be given a task. **What you bring** * Solid SQL on a modern relational platform, Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible), with stored procedures and views that hold up in use. * Practical skill in query tuning, data loading, and connectivity, with version control and clean delivery. * Practical experience developing logical data models and database schemas, and making physical\-design decisions for assigned components within the established platform architecture. * The ability to own assigned database work from design through maintenance, with sound judgment where accuracy and auditability are not optional. **What you'll need** Sole United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination are required for this initial engagement. This is a hybrid role based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and it requires commuting into DC regularly. Everything else, including the years, certifications, and specific tools, we ask in the application and discuss during the interview. **What we offer** A high\-performing team of developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists solving complex, real\-world problems, with work that runs from strategy formulation to hands\-on implementation. And Peregrine has been a Benefit Corporation from day one: public value is built into the work itself, not bolted on afterward. Work worth your best years. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this opening and future roles.* **Requirements** * At least four years of database development experience * Bachelor's degree * SQL on Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible), working with DynamoDB, S3, and Apache Iceberg tables * Stored procedures, views, and query tuning * Data loading from S3 into the platform stores, plus Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) * Logical data modeling and database\-design decisions for assigned components within an established platform architecture * Basic proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Physical\-design ownership of Aurora and Iceberg stores, or the drive to grow into it * Access governed by Apache Ranger * Federal information technology or high\-volume transaction experience * Familiarity with artificial intelligence (AI)\-assisted developer tooling **Benefits** Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Docflow builds AI agents that run the back office for healthcare providers. Our automation handles the work that buries their teams: document intake, prior authorizations, order entry, and payer portal workflows. Customers start with a paid pilot, see real work getting done within weeks, and expand from there. We're a small, scrappy, AI\-native founding team, and we're growing fast. Every customer we sign runs live workflows that have to keep working, and there are more of them every month. That's why we're hiring you. The Role This is an engineering role that lives where the product meets the customer. You'll stand up new customer workflows alongside our sales team, keep the live ones healthy, and own the systems that make both of those faster every month. Here's how we work, and it's the most important thing to understand about this job: **we do the work manually first, then we automate it.** When a workflow needs fixing, you fix it. Then you ask the real question, which is how to make that fix faster next time, or unnecessary, or something the customer can do for themselves. We expect you to keep scaling yourself, handling more and more by building systems behind you. The person who does well here is constitutionally incapable of doing the same manual thing twice without trying to automate it. You'll also own our QA product. An agent reviews production runs against each workflow's requirements and flags the ones that fall short. You'll review its verdicts, accept or reject what it files, and then make the agent better at its job. That loop is this role in miniature: do the judgment work yourself, then teach the system to do more of it. To be clear about what this isn't: it's not a support queue in the help desk sense, it's not a pre\-sales demo role, and it's not a consultant embedded at a customer site. You'll write and review real code every week, from our office, with the rest of the team. What You'll Do * Build out new customer workflows with the account executive who owns the account. They stay in the lead and bring you what the customer needs; you make it real. We want this as close to real time as possible, and making it faster is part of your job, not a nice\-to\-have * Support live customer workflows: fix what breaks, then remove the reason it broke * Own our QA product, from reviewing what the agent flags to making the agent sharper * Own how workflow changes get published: make sure deployments do what they're supposed to, catch the changes that shouldn't ship, and roll back cleanly when something is wrong * Watch for patterns. A workflow that keeps needing the same fix is telling you something upstream is wrong, and chasing that down is worth more than closing the ticket * Build the tooling, checks, and guardrails that make everything above take less time every month * Learn our customers' industry well enough to argue with how they describe their own process What We're Looking For **Must have:** * Real professional software engineering experience. You'll write and review production code every week, and defend the business logic you wrote. * Strong TypeScript, or strong experience in a comparable typed language plus the appetite to get to strong TypeScript quickly. * The ability to read unfamiliar code fast. Much of what you touch was written by someone else, or by an agent. * An instinct to automate your own work. This is the single most important trait for this role. Doing the manual version first is the job; leaving it manual is not. * Genuine interest in complicated real\-world processes. Prior authorization rules, billing codes, payer\-by\-payer exceptions that exist for reasons nobody ever wrote down. If a twenty\-step workflow that nobody has documented sounds tedious rather than interesting, this will be a frustrating job. * A customer\-centered instinct. The account executive owns the customer relationship and stays in the lead, so you won't be on every call. But every judgment call you make comes down to what this looks like to the person whose order it is. * Comfort in a company of four to six people, where the job is whatever it takes and you'll largely define your own benchmarks as you go. * Willingness to work in\-office five days a week, and to be around some evenings and weekends when something critical breaks. **Preferred:** * Forward deployed, solutions, implementation, or product engineering experience where you also wrote production code * Experience in healthcare, revenue cycle, insurance, or another domain with dense rules you had to learn from scratch * Experience with durable workflow orchestration, browser automation, or long\-running job systems * You use AI coding tools yourself, such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor, to move faster * Based in Los Angeles, or ready to be We'll teach you the industry. We can't teach you to find it interesting. Compensation and Benefits * Base salary of $150,000 to $185,000 depending on experience * Founding\-team equity * Health insurance Compensation Range: $150K \- $185K

Engineers who want that loop rarely get it at scale. If that's the job you've been trying to find, this is it.**About the Role** ================== We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to build our banking platform and then take it into the field. This is a hybrid of product engineering and client\-facing solutions work: roughly two\-thirds building, one\-third embedded with the partners, vendors, and internal teams who depend on what you ship. The forward\-deployed part is the point. Most engineering organizations put layers between the person who writes the code and the person who has to live with it, and quality suffers in both directions. You'll close that gap. When an integration fails at a partner, you're the one who diagnoses it — not a support tier that escalates to a queue that eventually reaches engineering three days later. We also expect this person to be genuinely fluent with Claude — not as a novelty, but as core tooling. A small team competing against institutions a hundred times our size only works if each engineer's output is multiplied. You should already be building this way and be able to show us how. You'll work closely with the Senior Product Manager who owns the banking portfolio, and you'll have real influence over technical direction. We have opinions but not much legacy, which means your architectural decisions will still be standing in five years.**What You'll Own** =================== **Mobile Development — Flutter** -------------------------------- * Build and ship our customer\-facing mobile banking application in Flutter across iOS and Android. * Own the release process end to end — store submissions, staged rollouts, versioning, and the deprecation strategy for older clients. * Handle the parts of mobile banking that are genuinely hard: biometric authentication, secure local storage, session handling, offline states, and deep links from notifications. * Keep performance and app size honest on the low\-end devices real customers actually carry. **Web Development — React** --------------------------- * Build customer\-facing web banking experiences and the internal tooling our operations teams use daily. * Share logic and design language across web and mobile so the two products don't quietly diverge. * Build to accessibility standards — WCAG conformance is a regulatory expectation in consumer banking, not a nice\-to\-have. **Cloud Infrastructure — AWS** ------------------------------ * Design, deploy, and operate services on AWS — compute, storage, networking, secrets, and identity. * Own infrastructure as code so environments are reproducible and auditable rather than hand\-assembled. * Build for the availability and recovery expectations of a regulated financial institution, and be able to prove them to an examiner. * Watch the bill. Cloud cost discipline matters more at our size than it does at a bank that can absorb the waste. **Delivery Engineering — GitHub Actions** ----------------------------------------- * Own the CI/CD pipelines for web, mobile, and backend services. * Build automated testing, security scanning, dependency checks, and deployment gates into the pipeline. * Maintain the change controls and audit trail that a regulated environment requires — approvals, artifacts, and release evidence. * Make shipping boring. A deployment should be an ordinary Tuesday, not an event. **AI\-Assisted Engineering — Claude** ------------------------------------- * Use Claude Code as a daily part of how you build — across the codebase, in your at You Get Here** **What You Won't Get Here** The full path from commit to customer, owned by one person Anywhere to hide when something you shipped breaks Architectural decisions that will still be standing in five years A platform team that handles infrastructure so you don't have to Direct contact with the people using what you build Insulation from customers when a deploy goes badly Deploys in days, not release trains scheduled a quarter out A mature engineering organization with established process Genuine influence on technical direction from your first month Deep specialization — you'll work across mobile, web, cloud, and AI A mandate to define how a company uses AI, not to inherit someone's rules An existing AI platform team, or someone else's guardrails to inherit Budget for conferences, certifications, and continued learning A remote or fully flexible arrangement — this role is on\-site **Education** ============= * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. * **No degree requirement we'll hold rigidly.** Show us what you've shipped. Self\-taught engineers with production track records are welcome here. * AWS certifications are a plus and are not required. **Work Environment** ==================== On\-site at our Charlotte headquarters, Monday through Friday, standard business hours. Expect periodic travel to partner and client sites — typically a few days at a time, several times a year. Banking platform work occasionally means an evening or a weekend around a release, a core conversion, or an incident. We run a real on\-call rotation and we keep it humane.**Show Us Your Work** ===================== We ask candidates for this role to share code. A resume tells us where you've been; a repository tells us how you think. Send us **one or two repositories you've built** — ideally something involving Claude, a mobile or web application, or infrastructure you're proud of. Personal projects, open\-source contributions, and side work all count. **If your best work is proprietary, that is not a disqualifier.** Most engineers coming out of financial services cannot share what they built, and we're not going to penalize you for honoring an agreement you signed. In that case, tell us and we'll substitute a walkthrough conversation — you talk us through the architecture of something you built, the trade\-offs you made, and what you'd do differently. That serves the same purpose. What we're looking for either way: how you structure a project, how you handle the unglamorous parts, whether the README exists, and — where Claude is involved — what you chose to delegate to it and what you kept for yourself. We are not grading polish. A rough repository with clear thinking beats a tidy one with none. We will not ask you to complete an unpaid take\-home assignment. Your existing work, plus a conversation about it, is enough.**How to Apply** ================ Send a resume, links to your repositories (or a note that your work is proprietary), and a short note about something you shipped and then had to support in the field: what broke, what you learned from the people using it, and what you changed as a result. That story tells us more than a stack list does. If invited to initial screening, we'll ask you to share a portfolio or a few examples of your work so we can get a better understanding of your experience and creative approach. **Equal Employment Opportunity** ================================ *We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team that reflects the customers we serve. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. jobs.title: Founding Enteprise Sales
jobs.description: **Build the pipeline and drive qualified opportunities that accelerate Hypercubic’s growth and revenue.** **About the role** ------------------ We’ve built an initial enterprise pipeline through founder\-led sales. Now we’re looking for an exceptional founding salesperson to dramatically expand that pipeline, keep opportunities moving, and help turn early traction into a repeatable sales motion. Your three core responsibilities: * Own the entire top of funnel: sourcing, prospecting, outreach, and qualification. * Drive opportunities from first call, owning demos, follow\-up, and deal progression. * Work with the CEO on strategy, pricing, negotiation, and closing. You’ll have meaningful ownership over who we pursue, how we reach them, and how we advance opportunities. You’ll build the playbook through daily execution and customer feedback, with room to take on more of the sales cycle as you grow. **What you’ll own** ------------------- * **Create qualified pipeline.** Research accounts and generate opportunities through outbound, warm introductions, partners, conferences, and inbound leads. * **Run discovery.** Lead first calls, understand the problem and urgency, identify stakeholders, and establish whether there’s a credible path to a purchase. * **Keep deals moving.** Build champions, engage decision\-makers, identify blockers, and secure concrete next steps. * **Partner with the CEO.** Bring them into deeper demos, strategy, pricing, and negotiation with strong preparation. Own follow\-through afterward. * **Build the playbook.** Test messaging and channels, document what works, maintain an accurate pipeline, and use AI and automation to increase your output. Success means more qualified opportunities, faster deal progression, and more pilots converting into revenue. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * **Proven sales ability.** You’ve built your own pipeline and won complex enterprise business, ideally including six\- or seven\-figure contracts. You can point to deals you personally created and advanced. * **High agency.** You find ways into accounts and move independently without an established playbook. * **Enterprise judgment.** You build champions, navigate buying committees, and know when to push, adapt, or walk away. * **Technical curiosity.** You learn complex products quickly and earn credibility with engineers and executives. * **Sharp communication.** You write compelling outreach, run focused discovery, and get to the point. * **Disciplined execution.** You prepare thoroughly, keep an accurate pipeline, and follow through. * **Resourceful with tools.** You’re hands\-on with CRMs, prospecting tools, and AI. You build workflows that accelerate research, outreach, meeting preparation, and follow\-up. * **Ambition and coachability.** You take ownership of results, seek feedback, and want to become exceptional at your craft. You may be an AE who built your own pipeline, a standout BDR ready for broader ownership, or a founder who sold a technical product. You’re excited to be **Sales \#1**: own the playbook, learn directly from the founders, and shape the sales function as Hypercubic grows. **What success looks like** --------------------------- * A sustained increase in qualified enterprise opportunities. * More accounts progressing toward pilots and paid deployments. * Active deals with engaged stakeholders, understood blockers, and concrete next steps. * Repeatable sources of pipeline beyond the CEO’s personal network. * Driving the founders to spend more time in consequential bottom of the funnel customer conversations. * A repeatable sales playbook grounded in what actually wins business. We work at the intersection of program analysis, knowledge extraction, and agentic systems, applied to some of the most critical enterprise software in the world. We’re a small, deeply technical team in San Francisco, backed by top investors, and working with some of the largest organizations in the world. Compensation Range: $100K \- $160K

jobs.title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sylvan** ================ Sylvan is building autonomous revenue teams. We help B2B companies grow and protect revenue from their existing customers by identifying revenue\-driving signals and deploying agents that act on them at the exact moment, across every account. We work with customers ranging from fast\-growth startups to Fortune 500 enterprises like ServiceNow. Our ambition is to power the top\-line of the economy. We are guided by a core principle: no assholes, high mutual respect. We operate at high intensity, but with deep respect. Direct, honest, and no egos — just a shared obsession to win. We’ve raised $10M\+ from world\-class investors and strategics including TQ Ventures and HubSpot Ventures. We are a fully in\-office company based in New York City. **We will only hire A\-players and are highly willing to go above\-market in ownership, equity, and cash compensation.** We want world\-class builders who are excited by the opportunity to be part of a category\-defining company at the earliest stage. It won’t be easy. We’re going to move fast. But, it’ll be fun. **The Role** ============ You own a customer from initial data access through a working, trusted system: understanding their business objectives, constructing the context layer our agents run on, building and deploying the workflows, enhancing the agent harness as you learn what breaks, and then proving the whole thing delivers customer outcomes. The hardest part up front is the data. Every warehouse is a mess in its own way: tables nobody documented, three competing definitions of ARR, and a data team with an hour a week to give you. Until that resolves into something clean and usable, nothing built on top is trustworthy. **What You’ll Do** ================== * Understand what the customer’s business objectives. Sit with the customer's revenue and ops leaders, get to the goals behind the request, and decide what is worth building against. * Onboard new customers end to end. Scope data access, explore the warehouse with no documentation, and map a chaotic schema onto real business concepts. * Stand up the ontology and verify the mapping. Interview the customer's data team and business owners, resolve their own inconsistent definitions, and validate the mapping before anything gets built on top of it. * Build the signals and workflows on top of it. The predictions and actions the customer actually sees, and the agent harness behind them. When a step produces bad output for one customer, you diagnose it and improve it. * Own the value case. Agree the success measure with the customer up front, then build the case that we delivered against it: the analysis, the evidence, the technical substance behind a story we can point to. You’re honest when the number didn't move, and specific about why. * Make the next deployment faster. Validation frameworks, eval harnesses, reusable mapping tools — what you learn at one customer ships as tooling rather than tribal knowledge. **What You’ll Bring** ===================== * You work at the frontier of agent\-driven development. You've built your own setup rather than living on the defaults, and you keep finding ways to get more out of agents than they give most people. * 3\+ years in a technical, customer\-facing role (forward deployed, solutions, or software engineering with heavy customer exposure); former founders strongly encouraged * Deep data warehouse fluency. SQL, dbt, and real comfort in an undocumented five\-year\-old schema with nobody left to ask. * You can sit with a customer's data or ops team, extract what a business concept actually means to them, resolve the cases where their own people disagree, and encode it. * Applied data science literacy. Distributions, seasonality, validation design, calibration. You know when a result is noise. * Painstaking through to the artifact. You'll chase a broken join for three hours because a number looked slightly off, and you'll care as much about whether the customer can actually interpret the output. Correct data in an unreadable form isn't delivered. * You define success metrics rather than report on them, and you can build the case that the work delivered. You can also tell a customer their number didn't move and why. * You hold a technical position under pushback from a customer or from us, and change your mind for evidence rather than authority. * High tolerance for ambiguity and unglamorous work. Based in NYC, excited to be in\-office. **Equal Opportunity** ===================== Sylvan is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process \- please let us know if you need any. Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

jobs.title: Junior DevSecOps Engineer, AWS Automation
jobs.description: Peregrine Advisors is a firm founded on a simple conviction: the best solutions come from the people closest to the problem, given real ownership and the tools to deliver. jobs.description: #### **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Build a functional prototype of a mobile warehouse utility app designed to instantly count stacked warehouse supplies using ondevice artificial intelligence. * Train a lightweight, commercially viable custom object detection model (using frameworks like YOLOv8, YOLOv11, YOLONAS, or YOLOX) to recognize pallets, top frames, and layer pads across varying lighting conditions and angles. * Prepare and organize data by setting up a lightweight annotating workflow (e.g., Roboflow or CVAT) to label a dataset of 300500 images of inventory. * Export and optimize the trained model (via CoreML or TensorFlow Lite) to ensure it can run locally and offline inside the mobile application. * Build a simple, clean user interface (UI) that integrates the model to display realtime counting overlays and bounding boxes on a live camera feed or uploaded photo. * Cowork directly with one of the company owners to develop, iterate, and test the prototype. #### **Skills and Knowledge preferred:** * Solid foundations and strong skills in Python for training pipelines. * Experience with computer vision libraries (OpenCV, PyTorch, or TensorFlow) and 1\+ years of experience working with the YOLO architecture. * Proven experience embedding machine learning models onto edge devices, with knowledge of leveraging hardware acceleration (Apple Neural Engine, GPU) highly preferred. * Proficiency in mobile frameworks (Dart/Flutter, JavaScript/React Native, Swift, or Kotlin). * Familiarity with data annotation, augmentation, and model optimization. #### **Job Requirements:** * Authorization to work within the United States. * A problem solver capable of working independently and researching deployment bugs. * Candidates must provide a portfolio or GitHub link demonstrating past projects where an object detection model was successfully trained and deployed to production or an edge device (webcam, phone, Raspberry Pi, etc.) #### **Compensation \& Hours:** Start Date: Available immediately. Temporary Part\-Time Contract or Paid Internship (estimated 4 to 8 weeks). We are seeking applicants based in the Denver area who are available for frequent onsite collaboration. This role requires regular travel between our plant in Golden for team co\-working and hands\-on prototype testing. Ideal candidates must reside within a reasonable commuting area. Hourly Wage: $30/hour. Completion Bonus: A $5,000 bonus (based off completion) #### **About CTPS / Complete TransPack Solutions** Complete TransPack Solutions (CTPS) was founded in early 2017 to deliver on a single goal \- improve the returnable \& reusable packaging material asset supply chain by providing transparent and economically sustainable services to our customers. To accomplish our goal, we assembled a team of professionals that have individually devoted the majority of their careers to managing large\-scale packaging materials pools and programs to support rigid container manufacturing. Our Mission is to provide transport packaging material services and solutions supported by our commitments for continuous improvement, food safety and efficient processes to consistently exceed our customers' expectations

jobs.title: Project Manager / Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Position: Project Manager / Engineer** **Location:** Corporate **Reports To:** Vice President of Engineering **Classification:** **Exempt \- Salaried** **Summary/Objective** The Project Management role requires a highly motivated and organized team player who can plan, design and execute project activities on time and within budget goals while maintaining a strong customer focus. The Technical Support role requires a team\-oriented demeanor that can receive unresolved technical issues escalated from sales and/or service departments, impart troubleshooting guidance toward resolution and translate escalated issues into corrective actions with principals and/or internal training needs. **Essential Functions:** * Assist sales to design and develop specifications and drawings, equipment selections and material/labor cost estimates for strategic and custom projects including industrial, petro\-chemical, combined heat and power and power steam systems. * Review/prepare sales estimates and/or drawing and proposal packages that are for design engineers use or out to bid and prepare material, labor and misc. material estimates along with any exceptions/clarifications to our proposal in comparison to the job bid documents. * Assist sales process with Technical and/or Project Management customer presentations. * Sales assistance and project support will require travel and overnight stays as needed. * Prepare mechanical, electrical, piping and control drawings with AutoCAD and some Solid Works as needed in response to successful bid. * Prepare submittal packages including catalogue cut sheets for all items used on the packaged assemblies. * Review approved submittals and make all corrections as noted to conform the package system to the job/reviewed submittal requirements. * Develop and/or supervise development of construction drawings as needed! * Assist with the construction of the system as needed to maintain schedule, budget, and design integrity. * Develop “as\-built” documentation and drawings including Operation and Maintenance Manuals * Provide after\-shipment support as needed for successful system commissioning. * Develop and maintain key mechanical contractor relationships with respective contractor service/project critical contacts. * Serve as the senior Technical Support resource supporting escalated field troubleshooting efforts. * Serve as Technical representative, alongside other RFM site representation, to liaise with principals regarding product problem resolution and/or product improvements. Requirements: * Excellent Customer Service skills and knowledge. * Proficient in communications both verbal and written. * Interpersonal Skills * Safety Focus * Critical Thinking/Evaluation * Reasoning skills * Ethical conduct \& practices * Time Management * Personal Effectiveness/Credibility * Flexibility * Timeliness * Initiative * Change Agent * Microsoft Project and Visio proficiency * Aggressive hands\-on designer and problem solver * AutoCAD proficiency * Reading and understanding electrical, process flow and mechanical drawings. * Experience in boiler and pumping systems, piping design and layout, process and flow diagrams, electrical control, industrial steam, and power systems design * Experience in construction * Requires managing schedules, project budgeting and reporting to meet specific project requirements. * Verbal and written communication competence with team members, suppliers, and customers * Good computer, time management and communication skills * Good customer/vendor interaction and communication skills are needed to assist with proposals presentation and run projects to completion. * Strong networking and relationship building skills with other RFM sites, principals and associated key product suppliers. * Strong technical troubleshooting skills and ability to impart resolution guidance to others. **WORK ENVIRONMENT:** Versatility, flexibility, and a willingness to work within a consistently changing environment. **Supervisory Responsibility** This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities. **Work Environment** This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. This is largely a deskbound role; however, filing, correlating, reproduction and binding materials are required. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets, bend or stand on a stool, climb stairs, and prepare training and meeting rooms/spaces as necessary. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk, hear, listen, bend, squat, walk, lift, pull, push, and climb stairs. **Position Type/Expected Hours of Work** This is a full\-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. This position regularly requires long hours and occasional travel work as job duties demand. **Travel** Travel may be required for this position to customer and RFMCo. sites with out\-of\-area and possible overnight travel expected. **Required Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in ME, or related discipline preferred or Associate degree and 4 – 7 years of relevant project management experience; or 7 years of relevant project management experience. * 5 years’ experience in project management/estimating. * Ability to perform diversified clerical functions and working knowledge of GAAP and accounting procedures. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills**.** * Proficient in Excel, Word, and accounting software systems.) * Strong interpersonal skills. * Ability to understand and follow written and verbal instructions. * Ability to deal effectively with a diversity of individuals at all organizational levels. * Commitment to excellence and high standards. * Strong organizational skills; able to manage priorities and workflow. * Keystrokes a minimum of 45 wpm. * Versatility, flexibility, and a willingness to work within constantly changing priorities with enthusiasm. * Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand the primary language(s) used in the workplace. * Professional appearance and demeanor * Excellent attendance and promptness a must. **Preferred Education and Experience** Bachelor’s or master’s degree preferred. **Other duties:** Please note, this job description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.title: Python Developer, AWS Serverless
jobs.description: Peregrine Advisors is a firm founded on a simple conviction: the best solutions come from the people closest to the problem, given real ownership and the tools to deliver. We are a data and technology innovation hub and a Benefit Corporation working at the center of the federal government's mission to deliver for client stakeholders and the US public, looking for highly motivated contributors who thrive when trusted to own a hard problem and equipped to deliver the solution. Your first assignment In your first assignment, you will likely take user stories from refinement through production. The work may include: * Building cloud\-native, serverless, event\-driven application workflows on Amazon Web Services (AWS), using Lambda and Step Functions. * Integrating commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) products into the larger system frameworks built in\-house. * Building application programming interface (API) connections, whether internal or external, that support modern system architectures. * Creating data and document pipelines that automate manual, paper\-heavy work. Adaptability and a demonstrated ability to learn new concepts, systems, and tools will keep you ahead of program needs as projects finish and priorities shift. The work is real and hard, and it matters. This first assignment is a starting point, not the shape of your career here. We hire people, not seats, and move our best to where the hardest problems are. What you'll build* Modern cloud\-native systems that create exceptional business value through streamlined, automated operation. * Tested, working code you own all the way to production, including the defects you find and fix along the way. * Automation that replaces the manual validations, checks, and workflows that once lived in somebody's spreadsheet. * Routine deployments, with services shipped through pipelines rather than staged as events. * Artificial intelligence (AI)\-assisted development as the default way of working, with tools such as Amazon Q Developer across the entire lifecycle. * And over time, the firm itself, through the new capabilities, tools, and lines of business you help launch. Who you are You care about what you build and judge it by whether it works for the people who rely on it. You move with priorities as they change and see each new tool and domain as a chance to improve your craft. You communicate clearly, adapt across roles and clients, and care about creating public value. You experiment, learn from failure, and try again quickly. You would rather own an outcome than simply be given a task. What you bring* Practical command of modern cloud development, with the range to build something new or improve an existing system. * Delivery habits to match, including version control, unit and integration testing, code review, secure coding, and accessibility. * The ability to explain your work plainly to the people who depend on it and to listen carefully to what they need. * Precision in work where accuracy and auditability are not optional. What you'll need Sole United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination are required for this initial engagement. This is a hybrid role based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and it requires commuting into DC regularly. Everything else, including the years, certifications, and specific tools, we ask in the application and discuss during the interview. What we offer A high\-performing team of developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists solving complex, real\-world problems, with work that runs from strategy formulation to hands\-on implementation. We develop people across roles and clients, with extensive onboarding and sponsored training and professional development. And Peregrine has been a Benefit Corporation from day one: public value is built into the work itself, not bolted on afterward. Work worth your best years. What we commit to As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this opening and future roles.* **Requirements** * At least four years of software development experience * A bachelor's degree * Working\-level command of Python * Experience with modern languages and frameworks, and with version control * Familiarity with cloud development on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) concepts * Ability to turn a defined specification into working, tested code and own it through to production * Basic proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel Preferred* Exposure to Amazon Web Services or an Amazon Web Services certification * Federal information technology experience * Familiarity with AI\-assisted developer tooling **Benefits** Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer II
jobs.description: **QA Automation Engineer II** **Department** Quality Assurance **Reports To** QA Manager **Location** Chicago, IL or Remote (US) **Role Overview** The QA Automation Engineer II plays a central role in strengthening automated test coverage and quality practices across our TMS. This is a heavy automation and AI role: you'll use AI daily as your default way of working, not as an occasional aid, paired with the judgment to validate what it produces rather than simply trust it. You'll also help establish AI\-assisted testing as a standard practice across the broader QA team, working alongside our QA Analysts as a peer. This is deliberately not a developer role, and it's not a fit for someone who assumes they already know better than the team and process they're joining. We're looking for someone who cares about getting this right, wants to learn our TMS and Salesforce platform well enough to have real opinions about both, and brings genuine curiosity and process discipline to the table. **Responsibilities** * Serve as the standing review function for automated test coverage across the TMS, an ongoing part of the job every time new coverage is added, not a one\-time audit. * Flag unreliable, flaky, or false\-positive tests, including AI\-generated tests, before they're trusted as real regression signal. * Maintain and extend automated test coverage for Revenova's Salesforce\-native TMS, working within the approach and priorities the QA Manager sets. * Use AI tools daily as the default way of working: generating test cases from a spec, maintaining and refactoring existing suites, and accelerating review of test output. * Build deep familiarity with the TMS and the underlying Salesforce platform. * Champion AI\-assisted testing as a required practice across the QA team, working directly alongside QA Analysts as the foundation for how that practice gets established and maintained, not as something offered only to whoever happens to be curious. **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications** * Daily, hands\-on use of AI tools in real testing work is required, not a bonus. Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or similar. You can point to specific, concrete examples of how it changed your output, such as coverage reached faster or manual maintenance reduced. * The judgment to validate AI output, not just produce it. You can spot the failure mode where an AI\-generated test passes without asserting anything meaningful, or where AI\-assisted review misses a real defect. * 2\-4 years of hands\-on experience writing and maintaining automated tests (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Java), within an AI\-assisted workflow. Not required to have built an automation framework from scratch. * Experience reviewing or auditing another engineer's or team's test automation code, including AI\-generated test code, with the judgment to explain whether it's good. * API and integration testing experience; able to identify which layer a given risk belongs to. * A QA mindset, not a developer's. Genuinely cares whether the product works for the people using it, not about proving they're the smartest person in the room. * Genuine curiosity about process and the product; wants to understand how our TMS and QA process work before suggesting changes. * Collaborative and coachable; comfortable being the most automation\-experienced person on the team without making that a whole identity. **Preferred Qualifications** * Salesforce platform experience, including automating against Lightning/LWC UI, Apex testing basics, and sandbox/scratch org lifecycle. * Logistics, TMS, freight brokerage, or supply chain software experience, including understanding load tendering, carrier management, rating, dispatch, and EDI/API carrier integrations. * Experience collaborating with a distributed or third\-party test automation team. * Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Administrator) are a plus.

jobs.title: Research Development Scientist/Engineer II
jobs.description: #### **Position Summary/ Objectives** The Research and Development Scientist/Engineer II is responsible for the design, development, and improvement of implantable regenerative medical devices from concept through commercialization. This role applies engineering and scientific principles to support product innovation while ensuring compliance with design control and quality system requirements. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with hands\-on laboratory and product development experience and is capable of working independently to support both strategic and operational objectives. #### **Essential Job Functions:** * Independently contribute to the development of implantable regenerative medical devices in compliance with design control requirements. * Execute and document design control activities, including design inputs/outputs, risk management, verification, validation, and design transfer. * Design and conduct experiments, including feasibility studies, prototype fabrication, and characterization. * Analyze and interpret experimental and engineering data to support product development decisions. * Troubleshoot technical challenges across prototyping, process development, validation, and manufacturing scaleup. * Develop and maintain product specifications, test methods, and acceptance criteria. * Create and execute experimental protocols, technical reports, and documentation to support verification, validation, and regulatory submissions. * Collaborate with Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, and external partners to ensure compliance and timely project execution. * Support R\&D equipment calibration and maintenance programs in accordance with quality system requirements. * Develop and revise SOPs, work instructions, and technical documentation. * Maintain accurate and compliant design history file (DHF) documentation, including lab notebooks, protocols, and reports. * Ensure laboratory operations meet safety, organization, and inspectionreadiness standards. * Train and support R\&D personnel on procedures, equipment, and test methods. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives through established quality and change control processes. * Participate in crossfunctional and special projects as needed. #### **Competencies:** 1\. Innovation and Scientific Curiosity 2\. Ownership and Accountability 3\. Execution and Efficiency 4\. Collaboration and Teamwork 5\. Integrity and Ethical Practice 6\. Resilience and adaptability #### **Education, Experience and Certification:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biological Sciences, Material Science or related field required. * Minimum of 3 years of experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or minimum of 2 years with a Master’s degree, in medical device R\&D, preferably in regenerative or implantable technologies. * Experience with experimental design, material characterization, data analysis, and laboratory techniques. * Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing multiple priorities. * Strong analytical and problemsolving skills with a datadriven approach. * Effective collaborator with crossfunctional teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation * Experience with CAD software, prototyping tools or model software is a plus. * Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing multiple priorities. * Strong analytical and problemsolving skills with a datadriven approach. * Effective collaborator with crossfunctional teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation. Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. #### **Total Rewards \& Benefits:** #### **Regenity offers a comprehensive rewards package, including:** * Company performance bonus eligibility * 401(k) plan with company contribution * Paid time off and paid holidays * Medical, prescription, dental, and vision insurance * Companypaid life and AD\&D insurance * Wellness Program and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Tuition Reimbursement Salary Range: $85,000\-$95,000 per year Regenity Biosciences, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, marital or veteran status, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status. Regenity Biosciences celebrates the diversity of our team. jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior QA Automation Engineer** **Department** Quality Assurance **Reports To** QA Manager **Location** Chicago, IL or Remote (US) **Role Overview** The Senior QA Automation Engineer owns automated test strategy and coverage across our TMS, setting the direction the rest of the team builds upon. This is a heavy automation and AI role: you use AI daily as your default way of working, not as an occasional aid, and you bring the judgment to validate what it produces rather than simply trust it. You also lead how AI\-assisted testing gets established as a standard practice across the broader QA team, working alongside QA Analysts and other engineers as a mentor. This is deliberately not a developer role, and it's not a fit for someone who assumes they already know better than the team and process they're joining. We're looking for someone who cares about getting this right, wants to own our TMS and Salesforce testing strategy end to end, and brings genuine curiosity, process discipline, and the judgment to mentor others along the way. **Responsibilities** * Own the standing review function for automated test coverage across the TMS, setting the bar for what counts as trustworthy regression signal, not just applying an existing one. * Flag unreliable, flaky, or false\-positive tests, including AI\-generated tests, and set the standards the rest of the team uses to catch them. * Set direction for automated test coverage on Revenova's Salesforce\-native TMS, recommending priorities and approach to the QA Manager rather than simply executing an existing plan. * Use AI tools daily as the default way of working: generating test cases from a spec, maintaining and refactoring existing suites, and accelerating review of test output. * Lead how AI\-assisted testing is established and adopted as a required practice across the QA team, mentoring QA Analysts and other engineers directly. * Build deep familiarity with the TMS and the underlying Salesforce platform. * Mentor QA Analysts and other engineers, reviewing their automation work and helping them build their own judgment, not just their tool usage. **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications** * Daily, hands\-on use of AI tools in real testing work is required, not a bonus. Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or similar. You can point to specific, concrete examples of how it changed your output, such as coverage reached faster or manual maintenance reduced, and you've helped others adopt this way of working too. * The judgment to validate AI output, not just produce it, and to teach that judgment to others. You can spot the failure mode where an AI\-generated test passes without asserting anything meaningful, or where AI\-assisted review misses a real defect. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience writing and maintaining automated tests (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Java), within an AI\-assisted workflow, including experience building meaningful automated coverage where little or none existed before. * Experience reviewing or auditing another engineer's or team's test automation code, including AI\-generated test code, with the judgment to explain whether it's good. * API and integration testing experience; able to identify which layer a given risk belongs to. * A QA mindset, not a developer's. Genuinely cares whether the product works for the people using it, not about proving they're the smartest person in the room. * Genuine curiosity about process and the product; wants to understand how our TMS and QA process work before suggesting changes. * Comfortable being the most automation\-experienced person on the team, and comfortable mentoring others without making that a whole identity. * Experience mentoring, coaching, or leading other testers or engineers, formally or informally. * Experience connecting automated test suites to a CI/CD pipeline and troubleshooting flaky tests. **Preferred Qualifications** * Salesforce platform experience, including automating against Lightning/LWC UI, Apex testing basics, and sandbox/scratch org lifecycle. * Logistics, TMS, freight brokerage, or supply chain software experience, including understanding load tendering, carrier management, rating, dispatch, and EDI/API carrier integrations. * Experience collaborating with a distributed or third\-party test automation team. * Experience evaluating or selecting automation frameworks and tooling for a team. * Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Administrator) are a plus.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Platforms
jobs.description: Software Engineer, Data Platforms is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Software Engineer, Data Platforms assignments. * Grade cloud \& platform engineering solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Software Engineer, Data Platforms work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * Cloud \& platform engineering * Software engineering **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US. **Compensation** ---------------- Hourly rate confirmed after the interview process. **Application process** ----------------------- Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role\-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

jobs.title: Senior Back End Engineer
jobs.description: **About Altruist** Altruist is transforming the multi\-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. We partner with financial advisors nationwide, empowering them to grow, optimize time and resources, and deliver superior outcomes for their clients. We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you! **But first, our values** **Kindness** \- Kindness doesn’t *just* equal niceness. We listen to understand. We embrace, and encourage healthy debate and diverse perspectives. We approach conflict openly, honestly, and respectfully. **Brilliance** \- Humility is the skill we’re most proud of and possessing a growth mindset is always top of mind. We take ownership in everything we touch; regularly using our unique superpowers to reach a common goal as a team. We succeed and fail as one. **Grit** \- When challenges arise, we stay laser focused on achieving our mission and finding a way forward, even when it’s hard. We are nimble and maintain a sense of urgency, swiftly adapting to change and overcoming obstacles. ### **The opportunity** Altruist is in the midst of an exceptional growth phase and we're excited to hire Senior Back End Engineers to join our growing Engineering organization. We have multiple teams hiring for high impact \& high visibility projects, with a particular focus on the security, scalability, and reliability of the platform our clients trust with their assets. Our recruitment team will work with you to match you to the right opportunity to help you grow your career at Altruist. **This is a hybrid role, with an expectation of being in the office three days each week out of our Culver City office.** ### **Your impact** * Act as a leader and steward of engineering best practices, helping to mentor other engineers and develop impactful solutions * Independently take a defined problem from design through implementation and into production * Build and extend identity and access management capabilities: authentication, authorization, RBAC, and OAuth/OIDC flows * Implement improvements to our AWS and cloud infrastructure, including its security posture, configuration, and operational guardrails * Improve database performance, security, and optimization across high\-volume, transactional systems * Harden APIs, services, and distributed systems against failure and abuse * Contribute to production reliability: participate in incident response and remediation, fix root causes, and add the observability needed to catch issues early * Partner with our Security/CISO team to turn identified gaps into durable engineering fixes you design and ship * Analyze and solve complex problems spanning multiple user personas and workflows * Focus on building and scaling services and user\-facing web applications that are customer\-centric, performant, and secure ### **What you bring** * **Experience** — 4\+ years of software engineering experience building precise and scalable distributed systems with best engineering practices * **Hands\-on execution** — You can own a well\-defined problem end to end and drive it to production without needing close direction * **Full\-stack with a backend lean (a plus)**— You're primarily a backend engineer but comfortable working across the stack; a core engineering background is preferred over a purely product\-focused one * **A track record of building, not just reviewing** — You've shipped work in security, scale, or infrastructure. This is a builder role, not a Security/AppSec role: we're looking for engineers who own remediation and deliver hardened systems * **Education** — Ideally looking for a B.A. / B.S. degree in relevant fields such as Computer Science or similar Engineering/Mathematics degrees * **Technical aptitude** — You're technologically savvy and can easily get up to speed on modern tech stacks (we use Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, AWS, Postgres, Kubernetes, React.js, Typescript, GraphQL). * **Domain exposure (a plus)** — Fintech, payments, or other security\-sensitive, highly regulated environments * **Ownership** — The pride you put into every aspect of your work is unparalleled and undeniable * **Superb communication** — Intentional dialogue is a superpower. You listen as well as you share your perspective with others * **Resilience** — We're inspired by your unwavering determination to achieve success, no matter the adversity you face along the way * **Assurance** — Your confidence is brilliant, yet ego\-less. You possess a strong knowledge base, the ability to discover the unknown, and are open to differing perspectives * **Creative problem solving** — Identifying the problem is simply not enough. You're instinctually creative with your approach in finding solutions to roadblocks Los Angeles, CA salary range $185,000 \- $235,000 USD **What we bring** Attracting and retaining top\-tier talent is a priority. We are proud of the culture we’ve built and are cognizant of the ever\-changing professional landscape. Our dynamic offering of perks and benefits are tailored for you to feel your best while doing your best. * Stunning, amenity\-filled office spaces in Culver City, CA, San Francisco, CA, and Dallas, TX. Our offices are intentionally designed for comfort, collaboration, and productivity. * Competitive total compensation. * Premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance plans (HMO and PPO). * 401k savings plan with a 4% match and immediate vesting. * 16 week paid parental leave after one year of employment. * Professional growth and development opportunities including an employee mobility program and an annual L\&D budget allocation for each employee. * Company perks program (includes discounts on pet insurance, fitness, cell phone plans, and travel, etc.). * Financial guidance program (includes counseling on navigating debt, tracking personal spend, saving and planning goals, home\-purchasing preparedness, etc.). * One month work from anywhere policy (with the exception of a few countries). *Total compensation includes a competitive benefits package, along with a bonus program for eligible roles. For salaried positions, a salary offer will be determined by a number of factors including experience, skill level, internal pay equity, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs regularly to ensure* *fair, equitable, and competitive pay. At Altruist, we are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation by leveraging market data to inform our pay bands. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically in conjunction with performance review cycles. By evaluating compensation on a regular basis, we are able to reward high performance and ensure all employees have opportunities for growth.* *Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Altruist we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*

Wayne, IN office.* **About ArchKey** ArchKey is one of the nation’s largest privately held specialty trade installation and integrated facility service companies. We are a leader in designing, building and maintaining electrical, technologies and specialty systems. We’re the POWER behind making the improbable possible. We’re electrifying the nation, energizing the future and bringing communities to life like never before. What we do today shapes the vision of tomorrow. Our work impacts lives long after the building is done. This means we are committed to building in ways that are not just technologically advanced, but sustainable, scalable and equitable by all. We’re not just energizing infrastructure, we’re energizing careers, communities, and the future. Made up of the brightest minds in the industry, our team is our greatest asset bringing knowledge, skills, and experience to every project. This is more than a call to join us, it’s an invitation to be part of a visionary journey, to grow with us as we scale. **About the Position** As a Project Manager \- You'll take full ownership of large\-scale, projects from estimating through close\-out. You'll have the autonomy to make critical decisions while working with a collaborative team that values integrity, innovation, and craftsmanship. **Our Ideal Candidate*** Takes full accountability for complex high\-voltage projects, making sound decisions that balance safety, quality, schedule, and profitability. * Communicates effectively with crews, engineers, and clients, earning trust through technical credibility and follow\-through. * Models and enforces a culture where safety and compliance are embedded in every decision, not treated as a checklist. * Anticipates challenges, manages risk proactively, and identifies opportunities to strengthen client relationships and repeat work. * Thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-impact environment and is motivated by delivering excellence on critical infrastructure projects. **Day in the Life*** Lead Project Execution \- Manage all phases of electrical projects including setup, budgeting, scheduling, cost control, and contract interpretation. * Ensure Safety \& Compliance \- Prioritize jobsite safety through audits and strict adherence to OSHA 1910\.269, NFPA 70E, NESC, and company standards. * Manage Labor \& Materials \- Take full responsibility for labor productivity, staffing, and material procurement, including delivery, usage, and returns. * Collaborate with Teams \- Partner with foremen, field teams, engineers, and clients to deliver projects efficiently and profitably. * Drive Business Growth \- Pursue new opportunities, estimate targeted projects, and maintain strong client relationships to expand our reach. * Oversee Project Documentation \- Maintain drawings, field records, change orders, and close\-out documents with accuracy and timeliness. **Minimum Qualifications*** Experience \& Expertise \- (Preferred) 5\+ years managing high\-voltage (69kV to 500kV\+) OR industrial electrical projects in transmission, distribution, or substation environments. * Technical Knowledge \- Strong understanding of power systems, codes, and safety regulations. * Field Background \- 2\+ years of electrical construction or commissioning experience preferred. * Leadership Skills \- Proven ability to lead teams, problem\-solve, and drive results. * Software Proficiency \- Skilled in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook; familiarity with project management tools. * Education: Associate's Degree in Business Management, Construction Management, or Electrical Engineering/Technology; or equivalent on\-the\-job experience. **Travel** * Occasional regional travel may be required. **Benefits** At ArchKey Solutions, our benefits package includes competitive health insurance options (medical, dental, and vision), a robust 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match, paid time off and holidays, and access to wellness programs. Additionally, we offer professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, and employee assistance programs to support your growth and well\-being. We ensure that our benefits are designed to promote the health, security, and work\-life balance of our employees. Additional information is available at Archkey.com. **Legal \& Fraud Disclaimer** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We are an Affirmative Action, Equal Opportunity Employer. Beware of fraudulent job postings. ArchKey Solutions only communicates through official channels. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.
