jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Insperity** provides the most comprehensive suite of scalable HR solutions available in the marketplace with an optimal blend of premium HR service and technology. With more than 90 locations throughout the U.S., Insperity is currently making a difference for thousands of businesses and communities nationwide. Behind our success is the unshakeable belief in the value of our people. We value diversity, inclusivity and a sense of belonging. We celebrate work and life events, and we partner with our clients and communities to make great things happen. We’ve earned recognition time and again as a top place to work—named among the best by respected organizations like Glassdoor and U.S. News \& World Report. We’re also proud to be recognized for one of the country’s Top 50 Midsize Early Talent Programs through RippleMatch’s Campus Forward Awards. There’s never been a better time to be part of Insperity, and our best work is still ahead. Learn more at Insperity.com. **Why Insperity?** **Flexibility:** Over 80% of Insperity’s jobs have flexibility. We want your time to have balance, whether it’s spent with coworkers, clients, family or your community. **Career Growth:** Insperity provides many ways to grow with the company. We offer continuous learning programs, mentorship opportunities and ongoing training. **Well\-Being:** Our total rewards package includes generous paid time off, top\-tier medical, dental and vision benefits, health \& wellness support, paid volunteer hours and much more. We take care of our people so that you can do your best work. We are seeking a talented ***Senior Data Engineer*** to join our team. ***Summary*** This position is responsible for working as a senior member of the Enterprise Data Engineering team. Takes a proactive and creative approach to expanding and optimizing enterprise\-wide data and data pipeline architectures, collection of data from sources across the company, and visualization and reporting strategies of the collected data. Implements data pipelines, acquires, transforms, and optimizes data sets for various use cases across the company. Ensures data sets are prepared for easy consumption by internal and external customers. This position will collaborate regularly with developers, architects, analysts, data scientists, and business facing users across various data initiatives and will ensure architectures and strategies remain consistent throughout ongoing projects. Responsible for continued improvement of our company’s data architecture and visualization strategies to support next generation products and data initiatives. Builds a relationship with all levels of stakeholders to represent the team as a trusted partner across the business through their deep knowledge of the subject and proven ability to deliver valuable solutions. ***Responsibilities:*** * Creates intentional relationships with stakeholders of all levels to ensure solutions that utilize the data pipeline meet their needs and will provide actionable, data driven insights long term. * Identifies, designs, and implements process improvements with a heavy focus on automation, data delivery optimization, self\-service, and scalability. * Forms deep working relationships with stakeholders including Executives, Product Management, Centers of Excellence, and others. * Creates and maintains data pipeline architectures to meet continuing needs of stakeholders. * Assemble large, complex data sets that meet business requirements. * Collaborates with various infrastructure and architecture teams to optimize acquisition and transformation of data from a wide variety of data sources using SQL and other ‘big data’ technologies. * Innovates solutions to ensure easy visualization and reporting across the enterprise. * Defines and implements self\-service/highly scalable visualization and reporting strategies across the enterprise. * Ensures data security across all implementations, data centers, cloud providers, client machines, etc. * Encourages, challenges, and collaborates with team members to build and optimize our data assets into an innovative competitive advantage. * Helps lead team activities and serves as a catalyst and initiator for innovation and creation of new solutions. * Serves as a mentor, trainer, and inspiration to other team members and partners with teams within the technology department. * Leads efforts to find, evaluate, and explore emerging and upcoming technologies to keep the team abreast of new trends and on the leading edge of developing practices, tools, and state of the art. ***Qualifications:*** * High School Diploma or equivalent is required. Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent work experience in the Business Intelligence/Data Engineering field specifically, is desired. * Five to seven years of professional experience in information systems is required with at least three (3\) years’ experience developing, architecting, managing, or maintaining enterprise grade software systems, database administration, or similar discipline. **Technical Requirements** **Snowflake** 5\+ years of hands\-on Snowflake experience Strong understanding of: * Virtual Warehouses * Snowpipe * Dynamic Tables * Streams \& Tasks * Secure Data Sharing * Clustering and performance optimization * Experience designing scalable Customer 360 data models * Knowledge of RBAC and data security controls **DBT** 2\+ years of dbt development experience Strong experience with: * Incremental Models * Snapshots * Seeds * Macros * Tests * Sources * Exposures Experience implementing Medallion Architecture: * Bronze (Raw), Silver (Conformed), Gold (Business\-Ready) * Experience with CI/CD deployment using dbt Cloud or GitHub Actions **Data Integration** Experience ingesting data from: * CRM platforms (Salesforce, Dynamics) * Marketing Automation platforms (Eloqua, Marketo) * Web Analytics platforms (Google Analytics) * Advertising platforms * Product usage event data **Preferred Experience** * Hightouch * Fivetran * Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) * Customer 360 architecture and design **Additional Qualifications** * Excellent understanding and practical experience with MSSQL and other relational databases. * Proficient with unstructured NoSQL data storage tools and techniques. * Excellent working and functional knowledge of database architecture concepts and the fundamentals of sound enterprise technology architecture and design. * Understanding of modern data platforms and analytics technologies, including Hadoop, Redshift, Tableau, Power BI, Databricks, and related technologies. * Strong leadership, teamwork, and collaboration skills. * Strong consensus\-building skills and the ability to find common ground or mutual agreement across complex topics involving compromise, negotiation, and collaboration. * Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to management, peers, and stakeholders who may not possess a strong technical or data background. * Strong customer service skills. * Exhibits a passion for learning and continuous improvement. Takes responsibility for acquiring new skills and broadening knowledge. * Exhibits a commitment to the utilization of defined standards, governance, and processes. * Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to express complex technical concepts in business terms and maintain effective working relationships. * Proactive in identifying and recommending opportunities for improvement, efficiency, and increased reliability. * Ability to create technical documentation and effectively share knowledge among team members. This job specification should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbent will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required by the supervisor. *At Insperity, we celebrate the diversity of our employees and our leadership. Insperity is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.*

jobs.title: Co-op, Next Gen Platforms (NGP) Systems Engineering: January-June 2027 (Onsite)
jobs.description: Job Summary Co\-op, Next Gen Platforms (NGP) Systems Engineering: January\-June 2027 (Onsite)\&\#xa;\&\#xa; **Position Dates: J** **anuary 11** **, 202** **7** **–** **June** **30** **, 202** **7** Position Overview: The Systems Engineering team is a fast growing, creative and motivated group of engineers consisting of several engineering disciplines. These disciplines include, but are not limited to biomedical, mechanical, electrical, and computer science engineering. The team’s primary focus within R\&D is ensuring all new product innovations are safe, effective, and satisfy requirements for the final product utilized by the end user. The systems team works hand in hand with several other groups to drive all aspects of the design and development process including root cause analysis, device reliability, alignment on high and low level product requirements, risk management analysis, design verification, traceability, and creation of the Device Master Record. At Insulet, co\-ops are considered entry level engineers. This position is designed to provide the selected candidate with a broad exposure to the design and development process for medical devices that are used by patients around the world on a daily basis. The ideal candidate will have the desire to learn about and work with various functional groups on programs ranging from software\-only solutions to pure mechanical problems, while learning about the medical device industry. This position will be an integral member of the R\&D team directly supporting the product development phases of Insulet’s innovation pipeline of wearable pump technology. This role will provide exposure to several aspects of Insulet’s processes including but not limited to writing and interpreting product requirements, device integration, verification test methods, troubleshooting/design analysis, and design documentation. Responsibilities: * Partner with seasoned Systems Engineers on testing the product, identifying bugs, troubleshooting design issues and methods of improvement. * Work cross\-functionally to meet project deliverables throughout product lifecycle including FDA and international clearance or commercial release. * Participate in product design, technical reviews, and triage brainstorming sessions. * Develop requirements and risk documentation to ensure product safety and effectiveness. * Participate in engineering evaluations \& data analysis reviews. * Work hands on with lab equipment and execute various levels of testing. * Performs other duties as required. Education and Experience: * Currently enrolled in an accredited BS program in biomedical engineering, electrical engineering, computer engineering, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, or bio\-engineering. * 3\.0 GPA or higher Minimum Requirements: * Ability to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment with a passion for continuous learning. * Hands\-on and inquisitive, not afraid to challenge a design. * Passionate about improving the lives of others. * Technical writing ability. * Experience with lab equipment (testing). * Microsoft office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). * Effective communication skills. * Must display maturity and a high level of professionalism; exhibits dependability. This position is not eligible for employer\-based visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship needs. Additional Information: \&\#xa;Compensation \& Benefits:\&\#xa;\&\#xa;For U.S.\-based positions only, the annual base salary range for this role is $25\.00 \- $34\.00\&\#xa;\&\#xa;This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:\&\#xa;• Medical insurance\&\#xa;• Holiday pay\&\#xa;• Sick time off\&\#xa;• And additional employee wellness programs\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Application Details:\&\#xa;This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.\&\#xa;To apply, please visit the Insulet Careers site and submit your application online.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Actual pay depends on skills, experience, and education. Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non\-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. Insulet’s flagship innovation, the Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System, integrates with a continuous glucose monitor to manage blood sugar with no multiple daily injections, zero fingersticks, and can be controlled by a compatible personal smartphone in the U.S. or by the Omnipod 5 Controller. Insulet also leverages the unique design of its Pod by tailoring its Omnipod technology platform for the delivery of non\-insulin subcutaneous drugs across other therapeutic areas. For more information, please visit insulet.com and omnipod.com. We are looking for highly motivated, performance\-driven individuals to be a part of our expanding team. We do this by hiring amazing people guided by shared values who exceed customer expectations. Our continued success depends on it! At Insulet Corporation all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. ( Know Your Rights )

jobs.description: City: Washington DC Company: IDB Posting End Date: 18 September, 2026 **We improve lives** -------------------- The IDB Group is a community of diverse, versatile, and passionate people who come together on a journey to improve lives in Latin America and the Caribbean. Our people find purpose and do what they love in an inclusive, collaborative, agile, and rewarding environment. **About this position** ----------------------- As a Senior Software Developer Consultant in the Technology and Transformation Department (TTD), you will play a key role in shaping, developing, and modernizing digital solutions that support Portfolio Management across the organization. You’ll provide technical leadership and work closely with cross\-functional teams—including product, business, UX, and development—to design and deliver scalable, reliable, and user\-centered solutions that strengthen portfolio management, monitoring, and decision\-making. You’ll bring strong technical expertise and a strategic mindset to guide architectural decisions, connect systems and data, and support the modernization and integration of Portfolio Management solutions. Your ability to translate complex business needs into robust technical solutions, establish development best practices, and guide teams through technical complexity will be essential to improving interoperability and performance, ensuring solution quality and scalability, and continuously evolving the product. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * **Technical leadership of multidisciplinary teams:** Guide the product team—composed of developers, AI engineers, data scientists, and product design specialists (research, UX, UI)—by providing strategic vision, technical direction, and making key decisions to ensure product feasibility and success. * **Technical alignment with architecture and enabler teams:** Work closely with Architecture, Security, Data, and Integration teams to ensure all technical and product decisions are validated and aligned with institutional guidelines. * **Hands\-On Software engineering excellence and code quality:** Oversee the technical development process to ensure that solutions are scalable, maintainable, and secure. Lead by example through hands\-on coding and code reviews, promote best practices in development, enforce technical standards, and support the implementation of automated testing and high code quality. * **Management of the product’s technical roadmap:** Define and maintain the technical planning in coordination with Product Leads, ensuring alignment with goals and deliverables. * **Technology stack evaluation and infrastructure alignment:** Analyze the compatibility of new functionalities with the existing technology infrastructure and identify necessary improvements to the stack. * **Scalability and performance:** Ensure the system can scale to meet increasing user and data volumes, monitoring key performance indicators to maintain optimal speed and responsiveness. * **Integration capabilities** : Verify that the product integrates smoothly with other systems and applications, using an API\-first approach to enable seamless data exchange and functional integration. * **Risk identification and mitigation:** Identify and resolve technical challenges, develop mitigation strategies, and ensure development remains on track with the necessary resources to address technological risks. * **Working with a product mindset** : Work with a product mindset in agile environments, leading technical planning, organizing team tasks, and ensuring smooth communication with development teams, internal clients, and other key areas—with a focus on continuous value delivery. **What you'll need** -------------------- * **Education:** Master’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience in Computer Sciences, Information Technology, or related field. * **Experience:** Atleast 5 years of demonstrated expertise in software development, building and consuming APIs and web services (SOA, REST, XML, JSON, OData), with strong knowledge of authorization/authentication standards (SAML, OAuth, WebAuth, ADFS). Skilled in API tracing using SoapUI, ReadyAPI, and Fiddler, and documenting with Swagger/OpenAPI. Experienced developing applications on Microsoft Azure and AWS, with hands‑on use of cloud‑native integration services including Service Bus, Event Hub/Grid, Logic Apps, App Services (Web Apps \& Functions), API Management Service, and SignalR. * **Additional Knowledge:** 1\) Proficiency in AI and generative AI technologies and their applications; and 2\) Understanding of ethical considerations and the responsible use of AI. * **Languages:** You are proficient in English and in another Bank official language (Spanish, Portuguese, and/or French) **Required Expertise** * **Software development:** Proven hands\-on experience with C\# and the .NET stack, with strong programming skills and demonstrated proficiency in software design, design patterns, clean arc d understanding and practical experience with service\-oriented architecture (SOA) and microservices, including implementation using serverless and containerized infrastructure. * **Web technologies:** Experience with modern web development concepts and frameworks, including single\-page applications (SPAs), SPFx, Angular, and Dojo. Hands\-on front\-end development experience and proficiency with TypeScript or JavaScript are highly desirable. * **DevOps and infrastructure:** Ability to implement CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. * **Data management:** Proficiency with relational and non\-relational databases. * **Quality assurance:** Knowledge of automated testing—including unit, integration, end\-to\-end, and contract testing—and frameworks such as xUnit and Playwright. A quality\-driven mindset is essential. * **Artificial intelligence:** Knowledge of LLM integration, prompt engineering, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architectures. Familiarity with Python, machine learning, and deep learning is highly desirable. * **Development tools:** Proficiency with code\-versioning and issue\-tracking tools; familiarity with the Atlassian ecosystem is preferred. * **Leadership and collaboration:** Ability to lead agile, cross\-functional teams, strengthen team members’ capabilities, and promote effective collaboration in support of business and technology needs. * **Communication:** Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including technical writing, documentation, and diagramming. **Requirements** ---------------- * Citizenship: You are a citizen of one of our 48\-member countries . We may offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your eligible dependents). * Consanguinity: You have no family members (up to the fourth degree of consanguinity and second degree of affinity, including spouse) working at the IDB, IDB Invest, or IDB Lab. **Type of contract and duration** --------------------------------- International consultant Full\-Time, 12 months (up to 48 months, subject to eligibility). **What we offer** ----------------- The IDB Group provides benefits that respond to the different needs and moments of an employee’s life. These benefits include: * A **competitive compensation** package. * **Leaves and vacations** : 2 days per month of contract \+ gender\-neutral parental leave. * **Health Insurance** : The IDB Group provides a monthly allowance to supplement the purchase of health insurance. * **Savings plan** : The IDB Group cares about your future, depending on the length of the contract, you will receive a monthly savings plan allowance. * We offer assistance with **relocation and visa applications** for you and your family when it applies. * ***On\-site position*** *with the occasional flexibility of teleworking.* * **Development support** : We offer learning opportunities to boost your professional profile, such as seminars, 1:1 professional counseling, and much more. * **Health and well\-being** : Access to our Health Services Center that provides preventive care and health education for employees. * **Other office amenities (as available):** Lactation Room, Daycare Center, Gym, Bike Racks, Parking, spouse career support, and others. **Our culture** --------------- At the **IDB Group** , we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. Our people consistently strive for excellence, and we recognize and celebrate the impact of their contributions. In our efforts to drive innovation, we intentionally include all voices, cultivate a sense of belonging and champion fairness. We welcome individuals from underrepresented groups to join us and share their unique perspectives. We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job interview process. If you require an accommodation to complete this application, please email us at accommodations@iadb.org .

jobs.title: BIM VDC Coordinator
jobs.description: About Us: **Intermountain Electric (IME)** brings decades of experience as a trusted leader in electrical contracting. Founded in 1946, we began as a small company in Denver, CO, and have since grown to be part of the largest specialty contractor in North America. Today, we work with owners and contractors nationwide, delivering complex construction solutions across various industries, including aviation, mission critical, entertainment, and healthcare. At IME, our people are our most valuable asset. We are committed to fostering a culture that prioritizes safety, quality, and professional growth. Joining IME is more than just finding a job—it's about building a career with opportunities to advance and make an organizational impact. Power your future with IME and be a part of a team that drives success in every project. About this Role: Intermountain Electric, Inc. (IME) is celebrating 80 years of powering progress across Colorado. Our office teams help deliver safe, smart, and reliable electrical solutions through our people and partnerships, the IME Way. Through strategic planning, collaboration, and technical excellence, and guided by our values of Integrity, Safety, Ingenuity, Relationships, Craftsmanship, and Spark, we empower our professionals to innovate, support our field teams, and strengthen the partnerships that move our work forward. Join a team where your expertise fuels the systems that keep communities running! The BIM VDC Coordinator supports electrical construction projects by bridging the gap between BIM VDC Detailers and Leads to ensure coordinated, high\-quality models and consistent project standards. This role facilitates communication across teams, supports model management and clash detection, and serves as a key liaison between office and field operations. What You'll Do: **BIM Implementation \& Standards*** Assist in executing BIM VDC processes on assigned projects. * Support development and maintenance of BIM Execution Plans (BEPs). * Ensure adherence to company standards, client requirements, and industry best practices. **Modeling \& Coordination*** Manage coordination models using Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, and related BIM tools. * Perform clash detection and track resolution of coordination issues across trades. * Produce 2D drawings, shop drawings, and model\-based documentation. * Provide model extracts and coordination reports to project teams. **Collaboration \& Communication*** Serve as a liaison between Detailer I/II roles and the BIM VDC Lead. * Coordinate with architects, engineers, contractors, and field teams to ensure accurate system integration. * Participate in and occasionally lead coordination meetings. * Communicate effectively with project managers, foremen, and field crews to ensure constructability and timely issue resolution. **Training \& Team Support*** Mentor and guide BIM VDC Detailer I and II team members. * Assist with onboarding and training in BIM VDC workflows and software. * Stay informed on BIM VDC advancements and recommend process improvements. * Perform additional duties as assigned. *Additional duties as assigned.* What You'll Bring: **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities*** Proficiency with Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, or comparable BIM VDC software. * Understanding of construction processes and project life cycles. * Strong communication and collaboration capabilities across diverse project teams. * Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail. * Experience with cloud\-based collaboration platforms. **Demonstrated Accomplishments*** Proven ability to coordinate multidisciplinary BIM models and resolve conflicts efficiently. * Demonstrated success in maintaining project standards and supporting consistent BIM VDC execution. * Track record of fostering collaboration between technical and field teams to ensure constructible solutions. * Experience contributing to team development through mentorship and knowledge sharing. **Education \& Experience*** Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Computer Aided Drafting, or a related field, or a relevant combination of education and experience. * Experience supporting large\-scale projects preferred. * Electrical construction experience preferred. * Certifications in BIM VDC\-related technologies are a plus. What You'll Get: **Working Conditions:** The majority of the time you will work in a typical office environment. Occasionally, you may travel to a construction job site. When on construction job sites you will encounter typical construction conditions including extreme temperatures, noise, dust, mud debris, welding, leading edge, trenching, and shoring, sometimes in a confined space. You may be required to visit multiple locations during any one day. **Benefits Overview:** IME provides an industry\-leading comprehensive benefits package. Full\-time employees are eligible to choose from a variety of healthcare coverage options, which become effective the first of the month after hire. In addition, employees are offered a substantial amount of PTO and are immediately eligible to make contributions to a generously matched and fully vested 401k. **Salary Range: $76,500 \- $103,500***\*Final salary and rates are based on education, experience, skills relevant to the role, and internal equity.\** Established in 1946, IME is part of Quanta Services, the largest specialty contractor in North America. We base our business model on always doing the right thing and pride ourselves in finding the best processes and practices in everything we do. As an electrical contractor, we install and service the power and lighting to commercial and industrial buildings in the Western US. The statements included in this job description are not intended to be all\-inclusive and other duties may be assigned as required. Intermountain Electric, Inc. (IME) is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and to creating an environment free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. IME will provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees who are qualified for a job so that they may perform the essential duties of the position. IME strives to provide a safe work environment for its employees. Under applicable laws and regulations, IME conducts background checks on all final candidates. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. **This position may require occasional travel to project sites throughout the United States and to company headquarters in Denver, CO, as needed for project support, collaboration, training, and business operations.** Compensation Range: The anticipated compensation for this position is USD $76,500\.00/Yr. \- USD $103,500\.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications. Equal Opportunity Employer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and/or gender identity), age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and/or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. We prohibit all types of discrimination and are committed to providing access and equal opportunity for individuals with disabilities. For additional information or if reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application, interview, or hiring processes or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact us the Company’s Human Resources department.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Factory Orchestration
jobs.description: Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what's possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core. Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics. **Role** -------- The Intrinsic Factory Experience is an integrated human interface to define, manage, and monitor highly orchestrated factory operations. We build tools to help forward\-thinking factories deploy intelligent, flexible manufacturing workflows at scale. Our tools help manufacturing process designers to optimize their resources, factory managers to make sense of their operations, and floor workers to strategically direct their attention. We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Software Engineer to join our dynamic Factory Orchestration team. In this role, you will be responsible for not only developing human\-machine user interfaces (HMI), but also optimizing the performance and functionality of client\-side rendering, server\-side databases, and integration with other backend APIs in Intrinsic. You will develop the full stack of web interfaces for end\-to\-end factory orchestration tasks and play a vital role in the development of our frontend libraries and components, ensuring a cohesive and user\-friendly experience for all customers. The interfaces you build will shape our product and the role of the human in it. You are excited by the prospect of owning critical pieces of our user experience (including collaborating with the Product and Design teams, and developing tests). You have excellent development skills across the web application stack and are excited to be part of a world\-class, innovative, frontend team. **How your work moves the mission forward** ------------------------------------------- * Develop intuitive and innovative interfaces in collaboration with Product, Design, and Engineering teams. * Own the full stack of the Intrinsic Factory Experience web application, from database design to user interactions. * Build and maintain the backend logic and infrastructure of the frontend, including server\-side functionality and client\-side state management. * Monitor and improve the health (performance, robustness) of the Intrinsic Factory Experience. **Skills you will need to be successful** ----------------------------------------- * At least 3 years of experience with frontend web engineering, including proficiency in building client\-side (TypeScript/Javascript) software. * Extensive experience in building the full\-stack, including server\-side (Rust, Go, Python, etc.) software. * Experience with building visually\-rich web applications that enable deep user interactions. * Familiar with integrating databases, user\-access control, and basic authentication/authorization into web apps. * Ability to work with Rust, both for backends and compiled to web assembly for front ends. **Skills that will differentiate your candidacy** ------------------------------------------------- * Experience integrating web apps with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and/or Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). * Ability to design scalable web apps. * Understanding of interface cohesion across a variety of network bandwidths, multiple screen sizes, and differing client\-side hardware. * Experience building dashboards aimed at various user personas. * Experience with creating and maintaining an intuitive, high quality, accessible system of reusable frontend components in collaboration with Design and Product teams. *The base salary for this full\-time position is between $147,200 \- $200,900* *(USD**) \+ 15%* *bonus \+ equity \+ benefits. Your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your targeted location during the hiring process.* At Intrinsic, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Employment at Intrinsic is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Intrinsic does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. It is Intrinsic's policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at: candidate\-support@intrinsic.ai.

jobs.title: Industrial Engineer
jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Manufacturing \& Operations * JOB217645 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **Primary Function of Position:** The Industrial Engineer 3 will lead efforts to improve the efficiency of physical and transactional processes throughout the organization. In this position, the IE 3 will take a leadership role in advocating for a continuous improvement culture, executing projects of moderate to large scope across manufacturing operations, and driving lean improvement across numerous processes. The IE 3 may mentor junior staff and will be considered a technical SME. The candidate should have a strong track record of continuous improvement results, experience with project management and good soft skills. **Roles \& Responsibilities:** * Participate and may lead Industrial Engineering projects and activities. Projects may include value stream mapping, design reviews, new product development and introduction, new line or facility start\-up, and facility design. * Run structured technical problem solving investigations and utilize data driven analysis to provide recommendations and solutions to achieve improvement. * Evaluate operations and identify improvement opportunities, utilizing data analysis and metrics to build a business case, and deliver on execution. Monitor operational metrics including labor hours, WIP levels, and productivity, analyze data for trends, and collaborate with process owners to improve. * Review and analyze work cell layout, process flow, material flow, etc. Assess best practices. Recommend cost\-effective solutions for improving the utilization and efficiency of personnel, equipment and/or physical space. Lead projects that will result in improved costs and/or enhanced quality. * Perform duties and train in the areas of time standards, line balancing, simulation modeling, cost estimation, manpower planning, and continuous improvement. * Support large building or multi\-cell layout changes. May lead layout changes of moderate size with minimal oversight. * Upon request, perform strategic analysis and communicate findings effectively to various levels of management. This may include assessing long\-range capacity forecasts from analysis to recommendations and justification for facilities, equipment, and/or manpower requirements for new or sustaining product ramp. * May propose and/or draft reports or dashboards to support data analysis. * May build simple reports or dashboards for analysis and deeper understanding. * May maintain existing reports or dashboards as required. ### **Qualifications** **Skills, Experience, Education, \& Training:** Base Requirements * Bachelor’s Degree required in Industrial Engineering or related discipline, and 4 years minimum of applicable, progressive work experience. * Strong verbal communication and group presentation skills required. * Proficient general software and data analysis skills required (e.g. Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.) * General project management skills. * Ability to lead small to moderately sized change management initiatives. * Proven ability to manage many projects concurrently and in a timely fashion. * Advocating for Lean Manufacturing programs within the manufacturing operation. * Understands implications of change and can work within Quality Systems. * Minimal travel required (\<10%). Preferred Requirements * Advanced data analysis skillset (e.g. Tableau, VBA, R, etc.) preferred. * Simulation modeling experience (e.g. Simul8, Arena, etc) preferred. * Experience working in medical device manufacturing and knowledge of industry regulations preferred. * Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification with project experience preferred. * New Product Development/Introduction experience preferred. * Facility design experienced preferred ( AutoCAD). ### **Additional Information** Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID\-19\. Details can vary by role. Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws. Mandatory Notices U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743\.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status. Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6\+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process). For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws. Preference will be given to qualified candidates who do not reside, or plan to reside, in Alabama, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Indiana, Iowa, Louisiana, Maryland, Mississippi, Missouri, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, or Tennessee. This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills. Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law. We provide market\-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, benefits, and equity. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors, including experience, skills, and qualifications. The target compensation ranges are listed. Accommodation \& Accessibility Notice: Intuitive is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please contact People Services at HRHelpNow@intusurg.com. **Base Compensation Range Region 1:** $113,200 USD \- $162,800 USD **Base Compensation Range Region 2:** $96,200 USD \- $138,400 USD **Shift:** Day **Workplace Type:** Onsite \- This job is fully onsite.

Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **Primary Function of Position** This role is part of the Product Cybersecurity organization and contributes to improving the overall security posture of products. It involves leading and managing individual contributors while contributing broadly to organizational goals and deliverables. The position provides leadership to technical team members and contributes directly to products, tools, internal policies, and procedures. Collaboration across multidisciplinary teams and departments is essential to achieve security objectives within the organization. **Essential Job Duties** * Lead and manage a team of 4\-5 Product jobs.title: IT Technician II
jobs.description: We are expanding our IT Services presence in Central Pennsylvania and are seeking a Level 2 IT Support Technician to join our team. This is a hands\-on, client\-facing role for someone who can take ownership of complex issues, lead work in the field, and act as an escalation point for our Level 1 team. On\-site work is a regular part of this position, so you will often be the face of our company, and the ability to hold a friendly, professional conversation in person is essential. The right candidate is a strong problem solver who stays calm under pressure, thinks critically, and makes sound decisions quickly when a situation does not go according to plan. You will work across a wide variety of environments, including desktops, servers, networking equipment, and cloud platforms, and you will play a direct role in installing and standing up the systems our clients depend on. We will invest in helping you grow toward senior infrastructure and project leadership roles. ### **About Intulse, Ltd.** We know we’re biased but we love working here. We love the work we do, and the people we do it with. Come join us! ### **Description** **Character Requirements** ========================== * **Responsibility:** Innate desire to do more than what is expected * **Thoroughness:** Work with efficiency, completeness, and within reasonable timeframes * **Dependability:** Fulfillment of expectations without excessive oversight * **Determination:** Persistence to complete goals despite external influences * **Flexibility:** Willingness to adapt to the needs of multiple departments and respond to direction and vision of teammates * **Composure:** Ability to stay level\-headed, think on the fly, and make quick, sound decisions when problems surface in the field Intulse is a privately owned company with core beliefs founded in Christian faith and we hire individuals who share that faith and commitment to our core values. Please **carefully read** about our culture and core values to understand if you'll fit in our unique environment: https://intulse.com/church/about\-us **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Client Support \& Advanced Troubleshooting** ---------------------------------------------- * Serve as an escalation point for Level 1 technicians on complex desktop, server, network, and cloud issues * Diagnose and resolve problems across desktops, laptops, printers, servers, firewalls, switches, and wireless systems * Troubleshoot root causes rather than symptoms, and document the fix so the issue does not recur * Make quick, well\-reasoned decisions when a job does not go as planned, and adapt on the fly to keep work moving * Delight our clients with fast, respectful, and helpful service **Hands\-On Installation \& Field Work** ---------------------------------------- Installation and field work is part of this role, mainly during project phases. Day to day, the focus is on support, troubleshooting, and infrastructure work. * Install and configure hardware and networking equipment, including firewalls, switches, wireless access points, servers, workstations, and peripherals * Ability to run, terminate, and test low voltage cabling when a project requires it * Mount, rack, and cable equipment cleanly and to our standards * Perform hardware adds, moves, and changes, including physical relocations * Support onsite deployments, migrations, and infrastructure rollouts from start to finish **Networking \& Infrastructure** -------------------------------- * Configure and support VLANs, switching, wireless, and basic routing and VPN connectivity * Administer Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and file services * Support and manage endpoints and mobile devices, including iOS, through mobile device management (MDM) platforms * Support virtualization platforms (Hyper\-V, Proxmox, or similar) * Administer Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace environments * Support backup, recovery, and business continuity systems **Helpdesk \& Documentation Tools** ----------------------------------- * Use our ticketing system to track and resolve all work * Ensure tickets are updated promptly and not left “stale” * Split and categorize issues properly when multiple concerns are reported * Create and maintain client documentation, network diagrams, and SOPs in our IT documentation tool and other systems **Remote Monitoring \& Management (RMM)** ----------------------------------------- * Monitor dashboards and alerts and follow up with defined remediation steps * Execute regularly scheduled or automated tasks as outlined in procedures * Identify recurring patterns and recommend proactive fixes **Project Work** ---------------- * Lead or assist with project phases, including hardware installs, network refreshes, and migrations * Coordinate onsite work and support senior engineers on larger infrastructure rollouts * Help plan and sequence work so installations go smoothly the first time **Communication \& Repo ropriately to senior team members when needed * Submit accurate timesheets and expense reports * Flag risks or recurring issues to the Service Manager and project leads * Ability to use AI to multiply your skills and save time, without using it as a replacement for critical thinking or feeding it inappropriate data such as personally identifiable information **Team Collaboration \& Mentorship** ------------------------------------ * Follow weekly schedules and dispatch assignments * Support and mentor Level 1 technicians, sharing knowledge and helping them grow * Participate in process improvements and feedback loops * Support our team's security posture by adhering to SOPs and staying vigilant * Show initiative by suggesting improvements, raising flags, and helping us serve better **Physical \& Travel Requirements** =================================== * Must be able to perform physical installation work, including hardware, networking equipment, servers, computers, and occasional low voltage cabling * Must be able to lift and transport IT hardware (servers, UPS units, switches, and similar) up to 50 pounds * Must be comfortable working on lifts or ladders for access points, cabling, and mounted equipment * Must be able to bend, kneel, reach, and work in tight spaces such as server rooms and network closets * Regular travel across Central PA using your own vehicle (mileage reimbursed) * Valid PA driver's license and reliable transportation required **Schedule Requirements** ========================= * Standard hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (eastern time), Monday through Friday * This role requires flexibility. There will be times when project or support work calls for starting earlier or staying later to see a job through to completion. * Many of our clients, including churches, operate outside of standard business hours. Occasional evening or weekend work is part of this role, such as supporting a Sunday service or performing after\-hours maintenance when it is least disruptive to the client. * Some projects are time sensitive and, once started, must be finished before the workday ends, to avoid leaving a client in a “half broken” state. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of getting the job done right. * We are only considering candidates local to our Lancaster, PA office. * We work in the office 2 days a week. **Required Skills \& Experience** ================================= **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * 4\+ years in an IT support, helpdesk, or field technician role * Strong Windows and Windows Server administration experience (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, file services) * Apple/macOS and iOS device support experience * Experience with mobile device management (MDM) platforms (Intune, Jamf, or similar) * Solid networking skills: TCP/IP, VLANs, switching, wireless, and basic routing and VPN * Hands\-on experience installing and configuring firewalls, switches, and wireless access points * Familiarity with running and terminating low voltage cabling * Comfortable using ticketing, RMM, and remote support tools * Strong critical thinking skills and the ability to make quick, sound decisions in the field * Clear written and verbal communicator, comfortable and professional in face\-to\-face client interactions, with a self\-directed work ethic **Preferred (Not Required)** ---------------------------- * Prior experience in an MSP or multi\-client support environment * Experience supporting church or non\-profit organizations * Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace admin experience * Experience with virtualization (Hyper\-V, Proxmox, etc.) * Experience with Ubiquiti UniFi networking * Relevant certifications (CompTIA Network\+, Security\+, Microsoft, or similar) **Benefits** ============ * Profit sharing * Healthcare options * 401K retirement plan with generous company matching * Generous PTO * Weekly company provided lunches * Work from home flexibility #### **Salary** $72,000 \- $85,000 per year

jobs.title: Quality Control Inspector Trainee, Non-Destructive Testing (1st Shift)
jobs.description: Company Overview: Imagine a piloted air taxi that takes off vertically, then quietly carries you and your fellow passengers over the congested city streets below, enabling you to spend more time with the people and places that matter most. Since 2009, our team has worked steadily to make this dream a reality. We’ve designed and tested many generations of prototype aircraft capable of serving in a network of electric air taxis. We’re looking for talented, committed individuals to join our team as we push onward toward certifying the Joby aircraft, scaling our manufacturing, and launching our initial commercial service. Overview: Joby Aviation is seeking a detail\-oriented Quality Control Inspector, Non\-Destructive Testing (NDT), 1st Shift to perform specialized inspections across our manufacturing, assembly, and component fabrication operations. Reporting to Quality Control leadership, this role is critical to evaluating structural integrity, material soundness, and engineering conformity across composite, metallic, and additively manufactured aircraft parts. **Please note:*** This single requisition serves as an overarching intake for NDT technical talent across four core inspection modalities: Ultrasonic Testing (UT), Computed Tomography (CT), Liquid Penetrant Testing (PT), and Eddy Current Testing (ET). * Candidates do not need to hold active certifications in all four modalities to apply. Applicants will be screened by Talent Acquisition and technical leads to determine appropriate functional placement and level alignment based on certification history, classroom training hours, and hands\-on experience. Responsibilities: * **Inspection Execution:** Perform non\-destructive evaluations on composite structures, metallic components, additive manufactured parts, and assemblies using one or more primary modalities: Ultrasonic (UT), Computed Tomography (CT), Liquid Penetrant (PT), or Eddy Current (ET) * **Equipment Setup \& Calibration:** Set up, calibrate, and standardize NDT equipment, sensors, transducers, probes, and X\-ray/CT scanning systems according to written techniques and standard operating procedures * **Data Interpretation:** Analyze scanning data, A/B/C\-scans, 3D CT reconstructions, signal responses, and surface indications against engineering drawings, acceptance criteria, and quality standards * **Defect Documentation:** Accurately document inspection findings, log results in MES/QMS databases, and generate nonconforming material reports (MRB tags) when discontinuities exceed allowable limits * **Method \& Technique Support:** Collaborate with NDT Engineers, Quality Engineers, and shop\-floor teams to assist with technique development, scan plan verification, and defect root\-cause investigations * **Quality Compliance:** Maintain strict compliance with FAA requirements, internal QMS procedures, NADCAP audit guidelines, and NAS 410 written practices Required: * **Education \& Training:** High School Diploma or GED * **NDT Experience:** 0\-2 years practical inspection experience or formal classroom/military training equivalent to NAS 410 in at least one core modality: Ultrasonic (UT), Computed Tomography (CT), Liquid Penetrant (PT), or Eddy Current (ET) * **Blueprint \& Specs:** Demonstrated ability to read and interpret complex engineering drawings and material specifications * **Quality Standards:** Familiarity with industry NDT qualification standards (e.g., NAS 410, ASNT, ASTM) * **Computer Skills:** Proficiency using manufacturing software (ERP/MES), specialized digital NDT analysis tools and Microsoft 365 Desired: * Technical diploma, military NDT training program, or Associate's degree preferred * Active or prior NAS 410 certifications (Level I, Level II, or Level III) in UT, CT, PT, or ET * Experience jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II, Customer Experience
jobs.description: Kard is building commerce media infrastructure that connects financial institutions, financial\-services platforms, and merchants through data and merchant\-funded rewards. As our reach expands, we are building for a step\-change in scale, and for opportunities ranging from more relevant rewards and marketer intelligence to new commerce and distribution models. ### **About the Role** The Customer Experience (CX) team owns the systems that power Kard's end\-to\-end rewards experience: transaction matching and the cellar pipeline, offer ingestion and delivery (including partner integrations like Rewards Network and SEATED), the cell\-based routing architecture, and the Support API that keeps our internal and partner\-facing tooling running. As a Senior Software Engineer II, you'll operate at the center of this — designing and building the services that ingest, match, and settle transactions at scale, while helping the team raise its bar on operational readiness, testing, and documentation. This role reports into the CX engineering team, with a strong focus on our issuer and partner\-facing surface area, working alongside Support, Design, and Product through Kard's Shape Up\-based pitch cycle. You'll drive pitches end\-to\-end, participate in on\-call, and help the team keep pace with a fast\-growing transaction volume and issuer surface. ### **Responsibilities** * Architect and build scalable services across transaction matching, the cellar pipeline, and offer ingestion — new work defaults to Go and Postgres; existing services are a mix of TypeScript and MongoDB. * Own features end\-to\-end through Kard's Shape Up cycle: discovery, pitch writing, implementation, testing, and production rollout, including a written launch/rollback plan for anything touching transaction or offer data. * Actively participate in on\-call, incident response, and IOC (interrupt/on\-call) triage; drive root\-cause fixes rather than one\-off patches (e.g., ingestion validation gaps, UID/timestamp mismatches, Datadog alert coverage). * Strengthen our issuer/client\-facing APIs and SDKs — reliability, clarity, and self\-service — so partners and Support can resolve more issues independently, reducing engineering escalations. * Lead by example: make decisive technical calls and foster collaboration across Product, Design, and Engineering to keep the team moving toward CX's strategic goals. * Champion enhancements to our tech stack, methodologies, and standards — authentication, rate limiting, deployment, observability, error handling, and test coverage (unit, integration, end\-to\-end) — with an eye toward resilience, agility, and quality, not just shipping speed. * Mentor engineers, contribute to design and architecture discussions, and help the team consolidate or deprecate legacy/overlapping services rather than letting them accumulate. * Write clear documentation and playbooks (local dev setup, deployment, troubleshooting) so ownership doesn't stay concentrated with one or two people. ### **Desired Skills** * Expert programming skills in Go and/or TypeScript, with experience building scalable, secure, high\-performance backend services. * Solid experience with distributed systems, event\-driven architectures (SQS, Temporal), and both relational and document databases (Postgres and MongoDB). * Proficiency with AWS and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform), including container technologies (Kubernetes/EKS) and serverless components (Lambda). * Experience working on transaction\-processing, matching, or ingestion pipelines where correctness and idempotency matter. * Comfort leading a technical project from discovery through production rollout, including writing clear specs and driving cross\-team collaboration (e.g., with Support, Data, or partner integration teams). * Skilled with agentic software development — using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) to plan and implement complex features, not just autocomplete — while still owning the design and quality of the result. * Commitment to fostering an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture. * U.S. core business hours availability and willingness to travel for company meetings. ### **Bonus Points** * Experience with card\-linked offers, loyalty, fintech, or another transaction\-intensive marketplace. * Experience with partner data ingestion (file\-based or API) and the validation/monitoring needed to run it reliably in production. * Familiarity with Cognito\-based auth, API gateway enforcement (e.g., Envoy), or claims\-based authorization. * Experience with Databricks or a similar data platform, and with migrating services from a legacy stack (e.g., Databricks to Postgres/Lakebase) without disrupting production. * Contributions to the tech community or open\-source projects. * Past success in startup settings, and a track record of empathy, collaboration, and productivity in remote work. ### **Compensation** * **United States:** $160,000 \- $190,000 USD * **Argentina:** $120,000 \- $140,000 USD **Why Join:** Kard recognizes the unique value each of us brings to our collective success. As part of our remote\-first team, you'll have the autonomy to influence our trajectory, actively contributing to the growth of our business and the evolution of our company culture. By embodying our core values of Initiative, Openness, and Humility, you will not only witness but directly foster an inclusive and dynamic work environment, from the executive level down. Our competitive benefit plan includes: * Flexible PTO, with a minimum requirement to take one day off a quarter, ten days a year, promoting mental well\-being * Observance of 11 Federal Holidays, plus an additional day each for Black Friday and Christmas Eve (US employees only) * Health, Dental and Vision Insurance * 401k with employer match (US employees only) * Coworking space and WFH setup reimbursement * Company Offsites for planning, team\-building, and networking Kard is an equal opportunity employer and we actively encourage applicants of all genders, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. We believe that diverse perspectives enrich our workplace and drive our success.

Performs research and troubleshooting to provide solutions for complex technical issues related to the security of infrastructure systems and applications. Responsible for managing cybersecurity related projects that impact the organization and the security of mission\-critical IT services. Contributes to policies and procedures that ensure IT systems are in compliance with the organization’s cybersecurity requirements. RESPONSIBILITIES** None **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** * Assess IT security risk and exposure on existing and modern infrastructure solutions on premise, hybrid, and cloud. * Recommend, implement, maintain, and monitor security solutions to protect IT Infrastructure systems including but not limited to Azure express routes, virtual network edges, vnets, resource groups, load balancers, NSGs, ASR, and Center partners, and 3rd party providers. * Administer, maintain, and enhance ACL’s, anti\-malware, anti\-spam, host\-based firewalls, internet content filtering, data loss prevention, patch Apply now for our Transportation Project Manager / Project Engineer (PE) opportunity based in our Richland, Washington office. This opportunity is also available for those who live close to any of our office locations. **Job Summary:** The Transportation Project Manager / Project Engineer (PE) will work closely with other engineers, technical specialists, and clients to successfully deliver innovative solutions for complex transportation infrastructure challenges. This is an exciting growth opportunity for a motivated person ready to take the next step in their career and contribute to our growing operations. **Duties/Responsibilities:** * Using local or AASHTO standards, oversee horizontal and vertical alignment, roadway sections, intersection layout and sight distance determination, interchange layout, utility plans, traffic control plans, signing and striping, roadway drainage including hydraulic reports, and right\-of\-way plans * Conduct planning studies, modeling, and hydraulic calculations * Develop plans and specifications * Prepare Preliminary Engineering Reports * Provide support for project bidding and construction administration * Mentor junior\-level staff * Actively participate in business development, lead generation, and contribute to proposals, presentations, and other marketing documents * Perform other duties as assigned **Required Skills/Abilities:** * Excellent project management skills and superb attention to detail * Ability to support contract negotiation and execution * Comfortable developing project fees and estimates * Demonstrated success managing aggressive project schedules * Able to prioritize applicable software such as Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project, BlueBeam, ArcGIS, AutoCAD, Microstation or other design software as appropriate and have the ability to participate in design and plan development **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related field * Five or more years of relevant professional experience * Current Professional Engineer licensure long\-term disability insurance * Company paid life insurance with option to buy up * Salary Advantage Program * Employee assistance program (EAP) * Flexible spending account (FSA) * Health savings account (HSA) * 401k match program \& access to asset management services * Year\-end bonus * Costco membership * Paid time off (PTO) and PTO sell back program * Paid Holidays * Parental Leave * Tuition Reimbursement * Paid day of community service We are a mid\-sized consulting firm providing water, wastewater, civil, transportation, and structural engineering services throughout the West including Oregon, Washington, Idaho, Nevada, and Utah. jobs.title: Senior Director, Technology Partnerships
jobs.description: About Kinaxis: **About Kinaxis** Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you! In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today. Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers. About the team: **Location** USA \- Remote Canada \- Remote**About the role** Kinaxis is seeking a **Senior Director, Technology Partnerships** to lead the strategy, development, and management of our technology partner ecosystem. This is a high\-visibility leadership role responsible for identifying, negotiating, and scaling strategic relationships with hyperscalers, data providers, AI/ML platforms, and other complementary supply chain technology companies. You will work cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Legal to build partnerships that drive incremental revenue, integrated solutions, expand market reach, and accelerate customer value. This role is ideal for a strategic, relationship\-driven leader with deep experience in enterprise software partnerships, technology alliances, or ecosystem development — ideally within supply chain, SCM, ERP, or related B2B SaaS domains. About the role: **What you will do** * **Develop the Partner Strategy:** Define and execute a comprehensive technology partnership strategy aligned with Kinaxis' product roadmap, go\-to\-market priorities, and long\-term business objectives. Leading with cloud and data/AI providers. * **Develop the GTM and the Ecosystem:** Identify, evaluate, and prioritize potential technology partners (cloud providers, AI/data platforms and other providers) to expand Kinaxis' GTM effectiveness, reach and enhance platform capabilities. * **Deal Structuring \& Negotiation:** Lead commercial and technical negotiations for new partnerships, including co\-development agreements, integration partnerships, and joint go\-to\-market arrangements. * **Uplevel Relationship Management:** Serve as the go\-to\-market point for key technology partners, cultivating trusted, long\-term relationships at senior levels within partner organizations. * **Drive Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to scope joint solutions, integrations, and roadmap alignment; collaborate with Sales and Marketing to build partner\-driven pipeline and co\-marketing programs as applicable. * **Own Program Governance:** Establish partnership frameworks, KPIs, and governance structures to measure technology partner performance, ROI, and strategic impact. * **Market Intelligence:** Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML, generative AI, cloud infrastructure), and competitive partnership landscapes to inform strategy. * **Initiate Executive Communication:** Report on partnership strategy, pipeline, and outcomes to senior leadership and the executive team. **How Success Is Measured** * **Partner Sourced Revenue** Bookings or pipeline that can be directly attributed to a technology partner referral, joint solution or marketing event. * **Partner Influenced Activities** Volume and quality of specific high\-value partner engagement actions including executive\-to\-executive introductions, joint customer briefings, marketplace transactions (e.g., Azure/GCP Marketplace), etc. **What we are looking for** * 10\+ years of experience in technology partnerships, business development, strategic alliances, or related roles within enterprise B2B SaaS, supply chain, or ERP software companies. * Demonstrated success negotiating and managing complex, multi\-stakeholder partnership agreements (technical, commercial, and legal dimensions). * Strong understanding of enterprise software ecosystems, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and data/AI technology partnerships. * Excellent executive presence, with experience engaging and influencing C\-level stakeholders internally and at partner organizations. * Strategic thinker with strong analytical and business acumen; able to translate partnership opportunities into measurable business outcomes. * Commercially astute and analytically rigorous, able to connect partner capability and customer outcomes to growth and retention * Exceptional communication, negotiation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. * Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or related field; MBA preferred. * Willingness to travel as needed (domestic/international). **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in supply chain management, planning, or related enterprise software domains. * Familiarity with AI/ML technology partnerships and emerging supply chain AI ecosystems. * Built and scaled partnerships in the Microsoft and/or Google Cloud ecosystems * Existing network of relationships with data, or enterprise software providers. * Experience operating in a scale\-up or high\-growth SaaS environment. **\#Director** Why join Kinaxis?: **Work With Impact:** Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P\&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more. **Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long\-term net\-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact. *People matter* at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee: * Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide days off) * Flexible work options * Physical and mental well\-being programs * Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes * Mentorship programs, training, and career development * Recognition programs and referral rewards * Hackathons For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com. Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. *Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role.
